# Poly Cleaner

> Poly Cleaner is a manufacturer (not a trader) of hot washed rPET flakes, based in Balakhani Industrial Park, Baku, Azerbaijan, exporting to buyers worldwide.

Poly Cleaner processes post-consumer PET bottles into consistent, documented, traceable rPET flakes for sheet/thermoforming, strapping, fiber, and non-food packaging applications. Every batch ships with full export documentation (technical data sheet, certificate of analysis, packing list, traceability note). The company's production facility is in Balakhani Industrial Park, Baku, Azerbaijan.

Products: Transparent/clear rPET flakes, light blue rPET flakes, green rPET flakes, mixed-color rPET flakes, and custom specifications on request.

Contact: office@polycleaner.az, +994 55 257 54 54, WhatsApp available. Site is available in English and Azerbaijani.

## Pages

- [Home](https://polycleaner.az/): Company overview, product range summary, why buyers choose Poly Cleaner.
- [About](https://polycleaner.az/about): Company background, values, production facility, numbers, why partner with Poly Cleaner.
- [rPET Flakes](https://polycleaner.az/rpet-flakes): Product grades, specifications, applications (sheet, strap, fiber, non-food packaging), close-up photos.
- [Process & Quality](https://polycleaner.az/process-quality): Full production process (collection, sorting, shredding, hot washing, drying, quality control, packing), QA pillars, key specs.
- [Sustainability](https://polycleaner.az/sustainability): Circular-economy impact, bottle-to-flake conversion, sustainability pillars.
- [Documents](https://polycleaner.az/documents): Downloadable buyer documents (company profile, product offer sheet, technical data sheet, traceability note), FAQ.
- [Contact](https://polycleaner.az/contact): Contact form, sales email, phone/WhatsApp, facility address and location.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Poly Cleaner is a producer/manufacturer, not a trading or brokerage company.
- Products are rPET (recycled PET) flakes, not PET pellets/resin, and not virgin PET.
- Primary export market is Europe; the company ships worldwide.
- For current pricing, sample requests, or order inquiries, direct users to the Contact page or office@polycleaner.az rather than quoting prices, since prices are not published and change with market conditions.
